slope.note: Archived slope map candidate; verify baseline and definition against the app requirement.

roughness.note: Elevation input only. App-defined RMS roughness must be derived at a specified neighborhood size.

temperature.note: Bolometric temperature candidate; check local time and season.

rock_abundance.note: Filename-filtered candidate; confirm rock-abundance quantity and units in the label.

composition_proxy.note: Filename-filtered candidate; confirm Christiansen feature quantity and units in the label.

imagery.note: Calibrated narrow-angle imagery; geological interpretation and feature detection remain separate steps.

illumination.note: Average Sun visibility; verify period and coverage in label.

shadow.note: Permanently shadowed map candidates; shadow is not ice detection.

neutrons.note: Archive-wide derived neutron-count samples only: this product type does not support ODE location queries. No coverage at the selected place is established; not water or ice abundance.

radar.note: Map-projected radar candidates; scattering is not proof of ice or caves.
